name: Saudi Arabia
shortSummary: Saudi Arabia is a top oil supplier and a growing strategic partner, formalized through the 2019 Strategic Partnership Council, with a large Indian expatriate workforce underpinning deep people-to-people ties.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Saudi Arabia is among India's largest crude oil and LPG suppliers.
Over 2 million Indian workers are employed in Saudi Arabia, generating substantial remittances.

recentDevelopments.title: Strategic Partnership Council ministerial meetings continue
recentDevelopments.description: India and Saudi Arabia continued institutionalized ministerial coordination under the 2019 Strategic Partnership Council framework.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reflects a maturing relationship increasingly institutionalized beyond energy trade alone.

historicalEvents.title: Delhi Declaration
historicalEvents.description: King Abdullah's visit to India, the first by a Saudi monarch in decades, produces a framework for strategic energy and security cooperation.

historicalEvents.title: Riyadh Declaration
historicalEvents.description: India and Saudi Arabia elevate ties to a Strategic Partnership during PM Manmohan Singh's visit.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership Council Established
historicalEvents.description: India and Saudi Arabia establish a Strategic Partnership Council to institutionalise high-level coordination, mirroring frameworks Riyadh has with other major powers.

agreements.name: Strategic Partnership Council Agreement
agreements.description: Institutional framework for ministerial-level coordination across political, security, and economic tracks.

defenceCooperation.name: Al-Mohed Al-Hindi
defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral naval exercise between India and Saudi Arabia.

multilateralRelations.detail: Saudi Arabia is a key node in the connectivity corridor announced at the 2023 G20.
